method: Strict evidence allowlist; no symlinks/junctions followed
All exported text decoded and scanned for credential URLs, DB connection strings, secret assignments, auth/cookies, API token formats, JWTs, email/phone and identity fields
JSON structure checked; DB fingerprints contain only counts and digests, not rows
All exported images decoded and verified; no EXIF or additional metadata present
Prior UI review and screenshot inventory identify anonymous public-content states; baseline overview visually rechecked
Archive bytes rescanned and each member verified against SHA-256 manifest
excluded_source: Entire source/ snapshot, including .env.example; canonical reference is the source SHA
excluded_runtime: Runtime static/media copies; only two non-sensitive runtime/var/reports/*.json check results retained
privacy_transformations: Participant names in narrative replaced with reviewer/coordinator roles
Local absolute workspace/profile paths replaced with portable references
retained_identifiers: Non-secret technical provenance only: localhost ports, DB/role/project identifiers, source/content hashes and aggregate counts; no credentials or DB rows
conclusion: No secrets, credentials, cookies, auth/session tokens, API keys, DB dumps/backups or personal-data records detected in reviewed exported content. Participant attribution has been pseudonymized.
limits: Content review and pattern/structure checks, not a mathematical proof of absence of arbitrary unknown secrets. Original evidence is preserved unchanged.
